Please carefully read this Privacy Policy ( the Policy), which explains the categories of personal information that
VIDEOSHOW Video Editor & Maker & AI Chat Generator
. ("we" "us" or "our") collects when you (the User or You) use our
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
through its website (the Website) and its mobile application (the Application) (collectively, the Website and Application are the "Services"), how that information is used, with whom it may be shared, and your privacy choices.
Important information about your personal information has been bolded, so please pay special attention to it.
If you do not agree to the processing of your personal information in the way this Privacy Policy describes, please do not provide your information when requested and stop using
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
. By using
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
you are acknowledging how we process your personal information as described in this Privacy Policy.

1.
Data controller
The Data Controller for the
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
Services is
VIDEOSHOW Video Editor & Maker & AI Chat Generator
, which has a principal place of business at 6 Raffles Quay, #14-06 Singapore 048580. You can contact the Data Controller by emailing
developer@videoshowapps.com

2. Collecting and Using Your Personal Data
Personal information refers to any type of information recorded electronically or otherwise relating to an identified or identifiable natural person, excluding information that has been anonymised. We may collect your personal data when you use our products or services or interact with us. Different types of data will be collected, depending on the service you use and your interactions with us.
In some cases, you can choose not to provide such data, but this may prevent us from providing you with corresponding products or services, or may mean that we cannot respond to or resolve any issues you have raised
.
We take all reasonable and feasible measures to ensure that the personal data collected is minimal and relevant to what is necessary in relation to the purposes for which they are processed.
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
may collect and use personal data as follows:
(1)
Personal data collected

Information you provide to us.

your email address,
account name, or other personal identifier.

order information, purchase token, the products you purchase, date and amount of the order, expiry date, currency code, country code.
l

prompts, text, images, audio, video recordings and chat history that you input
, depending on the features you use.

your IP address

your device information (e.g. phone model and
brand), operating system (system version, ID, and
language), clicking
and
the URL that referred you to our Services

l

information that your browser or device automatically sends
when you use our Services, such as
IP address, the date, time and number of times
of your visit,
and event information (such as errors, crashes, restarts, and updates)
. We also use web server logs to collect and store
information about service usage
.
Third parties may use tracking technologies in connection with our Service, which may include the collection of information about your online activities over time and across third
party websites.
This Policy does not apply to these third
party technologies because we may not control them and we are not responsible for them. Do Not Track is a technology that enables users to opt out of tracking by websites they do not visit. Currently, we do not monitor or take any action with respect to Do Not Track technology.

The prompts, text, images, audio recordings, videos and chat logs that you enter may be your personal sensitive data, and in order to provide you with certain features of our Services, we may collect, generate, access, store and use this sensitive information about you. We will only use this data to provide you with the applicable features, and by entering this sensitive information and sending us a request to generate it, you consent to us using it for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy.

3.
Sharing of Your Personal Data
Only when necessary will we share your personal data with the selected recipients, including:
l
Service Providers and Business Partners
We may share your personal information with companies that help us to run our business by processing personal information on behalf of us for the purposes identified above. Such companies include providers of payment processing services, server services providers, data analysis services providers, fraud monitoring and prevention providers, email delivery service providers, social media, and other marketing platforms and service providers. We use reasonable efforts to vet vendors for their privacy and data security practices. We require that such vendors agree to protect the data we share with them in accordance with this Policy, and access, process, or store your personal data only in the course of performing their duties to us. At the same time, we will clarify the privacy policy terms of these
vendors with you. They include:
(1)
Third party tracking tools:

may use third party tracking tools (such as
Google Firebase Analytics) to track the information on how users use the products and websites, such information will be stored in third party servers. Such third

is under a duty to disclose or share such personal data to comply with any legal obligation, or to protect the rights, property or safety of its business, its customers or others. We may share information with law enforcement, government authorities If the Request originates from a foreign jurisdiction, we will typically disclose information where we in good faith believe that disclosure is permitted by both jurisdictions. In all cases, we may raise or waive any legal objection or right available to us, in our sole discretion.

l

(including
but not limited to financial advisors, legal advisors) in business transactions (or negotiations for such transactions) involving a corporate divestiture, merger, consolidation, acquisition, reorganization, sale, or other disposition of all or any portion of the business or assets of, or equity interests in

(including, in connection with a bankruptcy or similar proceedings).
In such a case, we will send prior notification to you, and use reasonable efforts to require the acquiring entity to comply with this Privacy Policy.

4.
Links to Third-Party Websites, Products, and Services
To ensure smooth user experience, this website, our products, and services may contain links to third-party websites, products, and services. Our products and services may also use or provide products or services from third parties. We do not have control over third-party websites, products, and services, but you can choose whether to access these links.
We also have no control over the privacy or data protection policies of third parties, as such third parties are not bound by this Statement. Before submitting personal data to third parties, please read and refer to their privacy or data protection policies.

5.
Transfer of
Your Personal Data
We use global cloud services to process and store your personal data. Currently, our servers are located in the United States and Japan.
In addition, we may rely on service providers around the world to support our operations and provide services to you. As a result, your personal data may be transferred to third party service providers and business partners in different locations for the purposes set out in this Policy. If we transfer any Personal Data to a third country for one or more of the purposes set out in this Policy, we will do so in accordance with the requirements of applicable local data protection laws. If you object to the transfer or use of your information as described in this Policy, please do not use any of the Applications, Services or Websites and immediately remove all of our Applications from your user device.

6.
Protection of Personal Information
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
uses commercially reasonable and industry standard security technologies and safeguards to protect the Users personal data processed by
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
against unauthorized access, loss or destruction, unlawful processing and any processing which is inconsistent with the purposes set out in this privacy policy.
We also expect our service providers to protect information in the same manner. No data transmission over the Internet, mobile networks, wireless transmission or electronic storage of information, however, can be guaranteed 100% secure. Please note that we cannot guarantee the security of any information you transmit to us.
If any personal data security incident occurs, we will notify you, pursuant to local legal requirements, of the basic information about the security incident and its possible impact, measures that we have taken or will take, suggestions about active defence and risk mitigation, and remedial measures. The notification may take the form of an email, push notification, etc. When it is difficult to inform data subjects individually, we will take appropriate and effective measures to release a Security Notice. In addition, we will also report the handling status of personal data security incidents as required by supervisory authorities.

8. Users rights
To the extent required by the law of your jurisdiction, you may have one or more of the below rights. Before you exercise any of the below rights, you may consult your legal counsel if the laws of your jurisdiction stipulate below rights. You can exercise any of the below rights through your
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
s
account. If you are unable to exercise your rights through your account, please submit a support form, by emailing
developer@videoshowapps.com
.
(1)
The right to be informed
The User has the right to be provided with clear, transparent and easily understandable information about how
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
collects and uses personal data and its rights. This is the reason why
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
is providing the User with the information in this privacy policy.
(2)
The right of access
The User has the right to obtain access to its personal data (if
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
is processing it), and other certain information (similar to that provided in this privacy policy).you may request certain information about our disclosure of personal information to third parties for their own direct marketing purposes during the preceding calendar year. This request is free and may be made once a year.
(3)
The right to rectification
The User is entitled to have its personal data corrected if its inaccurate or incomplete.
(4) The right to erasure or deletion
This right to be forgottenenables the User to request the deletion or removal of its personal data where theres no compelling reason for
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
to keep using it.
(5) The right to restrict processing
Under certain circumstances, the User has the rights to
block
or suppress further use of its personal data.
(6) The right to data portability
The User has the right to receive their
personal data maintained by
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
in a structured, commonly used and machine readable format and has the right to transmit that
data to another controller.
(7) The right to object to processing
The User has the right to object, on grounds relating to its particular situation, at any time, to the processing of its personal data.
(8)The right to lodge a complaint
The User has the right to lodge a complaint about the way
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
handles or processes its personal data with its national supervisory authority .
(1)
The right to withdraw consent
If the user has given its consent for a specific processing of its personal data implemented by
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
, the User has the right to withdraw its consent at any time. In case the User does so, it does not mean that anything
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
has done with the Users personal data with its consent up to that point is unlawful but
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
will not use the users personal data for that purpose in the future.

9.
Children's Privacy
We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals who are under the minimum required ages specified herein. You must be at least 13 years of age, or the age of majority in your jurisdiction (whichever is greater), to use our services. Individuals under the applicable age may use our services only through a parent or legal guardian's account and with their involvement. In accordance with the Child Online Privacy Protection Act, in the event that we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under age 13 without verification of parental consent, we will delete that information as quickly as possible.
If you are believes
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
may have collected personal information regarding your child, you may ask us to delete such information by email us at
developer@videoshowapps.com
.

10.
Revision of this Privacy Policy
Occasionally, we may change this privacy policy (or other documents related to privacy policy) to allow
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
to use or share your personal data differently. If we do, the links to the policy on our application (which are generally found in
Setting) will indicate that the policy has been changed. For new users, the change will become effective upon posting. For existing users, if the change is significant, it will become effective
after posting. We encourage you to periodically review the privacy policy for the latest information on our privacy practices.

11.
Contact us
If the user needs to contact
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
for any reason (including to exercise any of its rights concerning data protection as set out above) please contact
developer@videoshowapps.com
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
will act on the Users requests and provide information free of charge, except where the requests are manifestly unfounded or excessive (in particular because of their repetitive nature) in which case
Video Editor & Maker VideoShow
may charge a reasonable fee (taking into account the administrative costs of providing the information or communication
or taking the action requested), or refuse to act on the request.

12.
Supplemental Terms and Conditions for Certain Regions
European Economic Area (
EEA
), Switzerland, and UK
If you are using the Services in the EEA, Switzerland or the UK (the
European Region
), the following sections of this article also apply to you.
International data transfers.
When information under our control is transmitted or transferred to a third country other than the United States or Japan, or stored and processed in a third country other than the United States or Japan, we utilize a variety of legal mechanisms to protect the transfer, including adequacy decisions, standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission, and other protections as appropriate.
If you would like to enquire further about these protections, please contact us at
developer@videoshowapps.com
Your rights
Additionally You have the following data protection rights:
(1)You can request access, correction, updates or deletion of your Personal Data.
(2)You can object to our processing of your Personal Data, ask us to restrict processing of your Personal Data or request portability of your Personal Data.
(3)If we have collected and processed your Personal Data with your consent, then you can withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawing your consent will not affect the lawfulness of any processing we conducted prior to your withdrawal, nor will it affect processing of your Personal Data conducted in reliance on lawful processing grounds other than consent.
(4)You have the right to complain to a data protection authority about our collection and use of your Personal Data.
Please note that in order to protect your information, we will need to verify your identity before responding to any request to exercise your rights. In some cases we may need to collect additional information to verify your identity, such as e-mail address.
How to exercise your rights
Under the GDPR, you may exercise these rights yourself or you may designate an authorized agent to make these requests on your behalf by contacting us at
developer@videoshowapps.com
.
For requests by an authorized agent, we may require you to directly verify your identity with us, and confirm with us that you provided the authorized agent permission to submit the request.
